table.retrieve:
select 
	T1.Customer,
	T1.CP,
	T1.address1, 
	T1.address2,
	T1.city,
	T1.date,
	T1.invoicecode,
	T1.regno,
	T1.patientname,
	T1.VisitID,
	GrossSales =isnull(sum(T1.GrossSales),0),
	SaleDiscount =isnull(sum(T1.SaleDiscount),0),
	saleinvtotal=isnull(sum(T1.saleinvtotal),0),
	srinvtotal=ISNULL(sum(T1.srinvtotal),0), 
	netsale=ISNULL(sum(T1.saleinvtotal - T1.srinvtotal),0),
	cgs=ISNULL(sum(T1.cost_of_sale - T1.cost_of_saleRet),0),
	profitamt=ISNULL(sum(T1.saleinvtotal - T1.srinvtotal - T1.cost_of_sale + T1.cost_of_saleRet),0),
	profitperc=(ISNULL(sum(T1.saleinvtotal - T1.srinvtotal - T1.cost_of_sale + T1.cost_of_saleRet), 0) * 100) / ISNULL(CASE sum(T1.saleinvtotal - T1.srinvtotal) WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE sum(T1.saleinvtotal - T1.srinvtotal) END,1),
	UserName = (SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode = T1.SalesManCode)
from
		(select 
					date=SL.date,
					invoicecode=SL.SaleInvCode,
					Customer = (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode=SL.CustCode),
					CP = (SELECT customer.cp FROM customer WHERE customer.CustCode=SL.CustCode),
					address1 = (SELECT customer.address1 FROM customer WHERE customer.CustCode=SL.CustCode), 
					address2 = (SELECT customer.address2 FROM customer WHERE customer.CustCode=SL.CustCode),
					city = (SELECT customer.city FROM customer WHERE customer.CustCode=SL.CustCode),
					regno = (SELECT P.RegNo FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode=SL.PatientCode),
					patientname = (SELECT P.Name FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode=SL.PatientCode),
					visitid = sl.custrefno,
					grosssales = sum(sd.looseqty * sd.saleprice),
					salediscount = sum(sd.looseqty * sd.itemflatdisc) + 
						sum(sd.looseqty * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc) * (sd.discperc * 0.01)) +
						sum(sd.looseqty * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc) * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (SL.DiscPerc * 0.01)) + ISNULL(SL.FlatDisc, 0) ,
					saleinvtotal=dbo.fn_getsaleinvtotal(SL.saleinvcode),
					srinvtotal=0,
					cost_of_sale=sum( (SD.looseqty + SD.BonusQty) * SD.avgprice),
					cost_of_saleRet=0,
					SL.SalesManCode
			from saleledger SL,
					saledetail SD
			where 
					CASE lower(:as_datetype) 
					When 'originaldate' Then SL.originaldate 
					When 'lastsavingdate' Then SL.date
					When 'billingdate' Then SL.billingdate
					END BETWEEN :adt_startdate and :adt_enddate and
					SL.Custcode = :ai_custcode AND
	 				SL.saleinvcode=SD.saleinvcode
			group by SL.Date, SL.CustCode, SL.SaleInvCode, SL.SalesManCode, SL.PatientCode, sl.flatdisc, sl.custrefno
			union all
			select  
					date=SRL.date,
					invoicecode=SRL.SRInvCode,
					Customer = (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode=SRL.CustCode),
					CP = (SELECT customer.cp FROM customer WHERE customer.CustCode=SRL.CustCode),
					address1 = (SELECT customer.address1 FROM customer WHERE customer.CustCode=SRL.CustCode), 
					address2 = (SELECT customer.address2 FROM customer WHERE customer.CustCode=SRL.CustCode),
					city = (SELECT customer.city FROM customer WHERE customer.CustCode=SRL.CustCode),
					regno = (SELECT P.RegNo FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode=SRL.PatientCode),
					patientname = (SELECT P.Name FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode=SRL.PatientCode),
					visitid = SRL.custrefno,
					GrossSales=0.00, salediscount = 0.00, saleinvtoal=0,
					srinvtotal=dbo.fn_getsrinvtotal(SRL.srinvcode),
					cost_of_sale=0,
					cost_of_saleret=sum( (SRD.looseqty + SRD.BonusQty) * SRD.avgprice),
					SRL.SalesManCode
			from srledger SRL,
					srdetail SRD
			where 
					SRL.date BETWEEN :adt_startdate and :adt_enddate AND
					SRL.Custcode = :ai_custcode AND
	 				SRL.srinvcode=SRD.srinvcode
			group by SRL.Date, SRL.CustCode, SRL.SRInvCode, SRL.SalesManCode, SRL.PatientCode, SRL.flatdisc, SRL.CustRefNo)  T1
group by 
	T1.Customer,
	T1.CP,
	T1.address1, 
	T1.address2,
	T1.city,
	T1.date,
	T1.invoicecode,
	T1.regno,
	T1.patientname,
	T1.VisitID,
	T1.salesmancode
order by 
	date,
	invoicecode,
	regno,
	patientname
